mapper.select: SELECT * FROM interview_session WHERE student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM interview_session WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND session_status = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO interview_session (student_id, target_position, interview_mode, total_questions, answered_questions, difficulty_level, session_status, current_stage, start_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{targetPosition}, #{interviewMode}, #{totalQuestions}, #{answeredQuestions}, #{difficultyLevel}, #{sessionStatus}, #{currentStage}, #{startTime}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE interview_session SET target_position = #{targetPosition}, interview_mode = #{interviewMode}, total_questions = #{totalQuestions}, answered_questions = #{answeredQuestions}, difficulty_level = #{difficultyLevel}, session_status = #{sessionStatus}, current_stage = #{currentStage}, end_time = #{endTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
UPDATE interview_session SET session_status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
UPDATE interview_session SET answered_questions = answered_questions + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
UPDATE interview_session SET current_stage = #{stage}, update_time = NOW() WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
